Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.solution: Remove infected leaves and avoid overhead watering. Apply copper-based bactericides weekly during humid conditions.

characteristics.spots: small water-soaked spots turning dark brown or black
characteristics.texture: rough and raised patches on the leaf surface

Pepper__bell___healthy.solution: Your plant is healthy. Maintain consistent watering, provide full sunlight, and avoid leaf wetness for long periods.

Potato___Early_blight.solution: Remove infected foliage, use disease-free tubers, and spray fungicides like mancozeb or chlorothalonil.

characteristics.spots: brown concentric rings resembling a target pattern

Potato___healthy.solution: Your potato crop is healthy. Continue irrigation and balanced fertilization. Monitor for pests regularly.

Potato___Late_blight.solution: Destroy infected plants, use copper fungicides, and ensure proper field drainage. Avoid planting during very humid weather.

characteristics.spots: irregular water-soaked lesions often at edges

Tomato__Target_Spot.solution: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and apply fungicides like chlorothalonil or mancozeb.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.solution: Remove infected plants immediately. Disinfect tools and avoid handling plants when wet. Use resistant tomato varieties.

characteristics.color: mottled light and dark green areas

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.solution: Control whiteflies (the main carriers) using neem oil or sticky traps. Remove infected plants and use virus-resistant varieties.

characteristics.spots: none, but leaf curling upwards is seen

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.solution: Avoid overhead irrigation, remove infected leaves, and use copper-based sprays weekly. Ensure good plant spacing.

characteristics.spots: small circular lesions with yellow halos
characteristics.texture: rough leaf surface around the spots

Tomato_Early_blight.solution: Prune lower leaves, rotate crops, and use fungicides containing azoxystrobin or chlorothalonil.

characteristics.spots: dark brown circular spots with target-like rings

Tomato_healthy.solution: Your tomato plant is healthy. Continue watering regularly and provide fertilizer rich in potassium and calcium.

Tomato_Late_blight.solution: Use copper-based fungicides and avoid wet leaves. Destroy infected debris and avoid watering at night.

characteristics.spots: irregular water-soaked patches with white mold underneath

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.solution: Increase air circulation and apply fungicides such as copper oxychloride. Avoid high humidity and wet leaves.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.solution: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or copper. Avoid watering foliage directly.

characteristics.spots: small circular spots with dark borders and light centers

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.solution: Spray water on undersides of leaves to remove mites. Use neem oil or insecticidal soap. Maintain humidity.

characteristics.spots: tiny white or yellow dots across leaves

Unknown.solution: The disease could not be identified. Please consult a local agricultural extension service for further diagnosis.
